name: HetrixTools Free
free_limit: Free forever: 15 uptime monitors and 15 server monitoring agents, with 1-minute checks from 4 selected locations, status pages, and 15-day activity logs.
watch_out: Must log in to the dashboard at least once every 90 days to retain the free plan. Additional monitors require a paid plan; phone and SMS notifications consume credits. Credit-card requirement and commercial-use conditions are not explicitly confirmed.
